args.title: Validate calendar dates for report from and to fields
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Validate that `from` and `to` date strings represent valid calendar dates (e.g., rejecting 2027-02-29 or 2026-04-31) before saving, returning a 400 Bad Request instead of letting Postgres fail with a 500 error.
